overview: The Medford Conservation Commission met to evaluate two Requests for Determination of Applicability and issued negative determinations for both proposed municipal projects.

items.title: Request for Determination of Applicability - Condon Shell Lights
items.summary: The Commission issued a Negative 2 Determination of Applicability for the City of Medford's proposed pavement repairs and light installations at the Condon Hatch Shell.

items.title: Request for Determination of Applicability - Mustang Loop Trail Maintenance
items.summary: The Commission issued a Negative 3 Determination of Applicability for trail maintenance and drainage improvements on the Mustang Loop Trail, conditioning the approval on retaining erosion controls for one growing season.
